translationRepairs: He befriended the Daoist Li Daoyin and Luo Yin; the age called them the Three High Recluses.
He befriended the Daoist Li Daoyin and Luo Yinzhi; the age called them the Three High Recluses.

Focus unit names 羅隱之 in full; the following unit abbreviates him as 隱之, not 隱. Rendering him Luo Yin drops 之 and risks confusing him with the Tang poet 羅隱; Luo Yinzhi restores the personal name accurately.
He was friendly with the Daoist Li Daoyin and Luo Yin; the age called them the Three High Recluses.
He was friendly with the Daoist Li Daoyin and Luo Yinzhi; the age called them the Three High Recluses.
The literal field has the same truncation of 羅隱之 to Luo Yin; Luo Yinzhi matches the Chinese personal name and is consistent with the short form 隱之 in the next unit.
Mingzong summoned him as Left Reminder, Gaozu as Censor—he refused both and was named Master Free Wanderer.
Mingzong summoned him as Left Reminder, Gaozu as Grand Master of Remonstrance—he refused both and was named Master Free Wanderer.

Focus unit has 諫議大夫 under Jin Gaozu; that remonstrance office is Grand Master of Remonstrance, not a censorate title. The proposed replacement corrects the office without altering the rest of the sentence.
He replied: “The Dao is that which subtly accounts for the ten thousand things in speech; one who attains its utmost can govern Heaven and Earth while the corpse lies between mat and coverlet.”
He replied: “The Dao is that which subtly accounts for the ten thousand things in speech; one who attains its utmost can govern Heaven and Earth while remaining still between mat and coverlet.”

Focus unit uses 屍居衽席之間 in the Daoist sense of remaining motionless between mat and coverlet; the prior literal 'the corpse lies' takes 屍 too literally. 'Remaining still' restores the intended stillness without inventing content.
He began as a common soldier and rose by battle merit to regent of Luozhou.
He began as a common soldier and rose through battlefield merit to become Training Commissioner of Mingzhou.
洺州 is Mingzhou, and 團練使 is Training Commissioner rather than regent.
In youth he was a common soldier; by battle merit he rose step by step to regent of Luozhou.
In youth he was a common soldier; through battlefield merit he rose step by step to Training Commissioner of Mingzhou.
洺州 is Mingzhou, and 團練使 is Training Commissioner rather than regent.

In the first month of the fourth year of Tianfu the Ministry of Revenue memorialized: “Li Zilun, Assistant in the Ministry of Revenue of Shenzhou, six generations dwelling together—per imperial order and statute.
In the first month of the fourth year of Tianfu the Ministry of Revenue memorialized: “Li Zilun, Assistant for Merit of Shenzhou, six generations dwelling together—per imperial order and statute.
Focus unit has 深州司功參軍李自倫; 司功參軍 is a prefectural Assistant for Merit under Shenzhou, while 尚書戶部 only memorializes. The prior literal wrongly makes him an assistant in the Ministry of Revenue.
He was promoted to Vice Director.
He was promoted to Vice Minister of the Imperial Clan Court.
Prior unit appointed him 宗正丞; this unit’s 遷少卿 advances him within the Imperial Clan Court to 少卿 (Vice Minister), not another Vice Director. The proposed title restores that promotion.
